profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, trading under the ticker TDC, with CIK 0000816761. On its own site the company describes itself as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. It presents its Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform as making AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale, and says its product and service portfolio covers AI, analytics, and cloud solutions. The company also states that it partners with leading providers to supply technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge.

The company's own material does not name individual products beyond the Autonomous Knowledge Platform, and no products or MCP servers are recorded for it. No lawsuits are recorded either. California is listed as a jurisdiction of law exposure with a count of 281.
